reason: My two or three salespeople only farm existing accounts, so nobody is opening the new market. The free list of 15 costs me 30 minutes, and if the targets are real forwarders' shippers and not random names, EUR 500 plus EUR 350 per meeting I can reject is cheaper than one trade fair stand and pays back on a single won lane.
objection: One logistics client with 45 meetings in 2 months tells me nothing about whether those meetings turned into contracts, and I doubt an agency in Sofia knows the difference between a shipper who moves full truckloads every week and one who sends a pallet a month. If the 15 companies look generic, I walk.
